system.description:
At your touch, pustulent decay blossoms across living or undead flesh, rotting teeth, bone and skin into festering ruin; this is the first and most feared gift of the Samedi's mastery of decay.

Best your victim in a Physical Challenge, retested with Occult, while expending a Blood Trait. On a success the victim suffers one health level of lethal damage and gains the Negative Trait Repugnant until the wound heals, the injury attended by rotting flesh, decaying bone and fungus-ridden sores. You may strike a victim multiple times to spread the rot, and the power affects vampires and even plants as readily as living creatures.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
